title: Spice.ai Dashboard
description:
Monitoring dashboard for Spice.ai runtime - covers system health, query performance, data acceleration, caching, AI/ML operations, and Flight protocol metrics.

Requires the Datadog Agent to tag Spice scrapes with `service_instance_id` (see the Datadog integration docs). This is Spice's instance-identity contract, not a Datadog-standard tag: the Agent does not supply it automatically, and without it the $instance filter matches nothing and every per-instance panel collapses into a single N/A series. Panels backed by the Kubernetes integration group by `pod_name` instead, the native infrastructure identity.
